about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Chile: 16 regions. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-CL-DPA2023.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship. Most sources are national, so they are listed once under country_layers, and each region points there.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:CL codes, CL-AI to CL-VS; CUT region codes 01 to 16 kept alongside, as strings with their leading zero.
codes.why: Bare AR, CO and MA already mean Arkansas, Colorado and Massachusetts in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). Chilean sources use CUT codes, not ISO letters.
codes.verified: Cross-checked against Natural Earth admin-1 (iso_3166_2); not checked against the ISO site.

layer_keys.crops: crops.sqlite (crop types, or land cover where no crop map exists)
layer_keys.roads: base map (OSM today); Vialidad roads as rural gap filler
layer_keys.hazards: no file today; tsunami and volcano layers would be new

DPA-2023-terms.name: DPA 2023 metadata conditions (no licence named)
DPA-2023-terms.attribution: Legend required: "Autorizada su circulación por Resolución Nº ... de la Dirección Nacional de Fronteras y Límites del Estado" (the archive and record disagree: Nº 87 of 2023, Nº 87 of 2019, Nº 50 of 2019).

postal_code.format: Seven digits: three for the delivery area (usually a comuna), four for one side of a block; xxx0000 for a whole comuna. Written before the comuna.
postal_code.notes: Correos de Chile offers a look-up page only.

addressing.order: Street, then number, then apartment/floor/block, then comuna and region ("Avenida Palena 1084, Depto. 505, 9180794 Estación Central"). Rural: "S/N", "Km 15", "Parcela 31".
current_code: tools/build_addresses.py selects country = US only; with that changed, the first two letters of the region name (state.upper()[:2]) give DE (Delaware) for 15 regions and ME (Maine) for Metropolitana.

engine/address_search.py treats a query as an address only when it starts with a number ("Avenida Palena 1084", "S/N" and "Parcela 31" are not), reads postcodes as \d{5}, knows English street words, and in "38 B" takes the B as part of the street.
The normaliser replaces letters outside a to z with spaces: "Ñuble" becomes "uble" and "Peñalolén" becomes "pe alol n".

regions.name: Aysén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo

source.publisher: SUBDERE, with IGM, DIFROL and INE (IDE Chile DPA working group)
source.method: Extent of every vertex of the region's parts east of 76° W (all of them, except Valparaíso's Pacific islands), read from the shapefile (SIRGAS-Chile, EPSG:5360).
source.cross_check: OCHA COD-AB admin 1 (from BCN, CC BY-IGO): within 0.07° for 15 of 16 regions; CL-MA 0.56° (OCHA lacks the Diego Ramírez islands). Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 5.1.1: within 0.21° for 12 regions; CL-BI 0.29, CL-AR 0.43 (Isla Mocha misassigned), CL-LL 0.44, CL-MA 0.62.

bbox.padded_note: west, south, east, north plus or minus 0.15°, rounded outward to 0.01° — the same margin map_sets.state uses for US states.

regions.box_share_note: Region area (SUPERFICIE, km²) divided by the area of the unpadded box.
regions.notes: Part of the border with Argentina in the Southern Patagonian Ice Field, along Magallanes and just south of Aysén's southern tip, is undemarcated (BCN: "Zona sin demarcar", 3,937 km², extent -73.64, -49.81, -72.87, -49.17). Points across it fall in neither the CL-AI nor the CL-MA polygon of DPA 2023. It lies partly inside the padded CL-AI box.
